fields.why: The brief says age is recorded always; 'Adults' defines the population, so age with role population belongs in the list (it does not raise the level).

Problems paying medical bills is the measured outcome; the article names no social or structural determinant as an explanation, so A's empty field fits the field's intent, though B's reading of a financial-hardship outcome as a determinant is defensible. A rule should say whether an SDOH/HRSN measure used only as the outcome is recorded in determinants_of_health.

brief_issues: determinants_of_health does not say whether a social-determinant measure that is the outcome (not exposure or explanation) is recorded; level-3 SDOH rule likewise covers exposures only. Age as population ('adults'): brief says 'recorded always' but readers differ on whether a population-defining age range counts.
